name: Rell
title: The Iron Maiden

passive.name: Break the Mold

description.normalized: Rell's attacks and abilities steal 2.5% Armor and 2.5% Magic Resist from enemies hit for 5 seconds, up to an increase of 12.5%. Max stacks: 5 per target. Her attacks additional deal 4 (5% Armor + 5% Magic Resist) magic damage on hit. Rell steals at least 1.5 - 3 Armor and Magic Resist. Does not steal from minions or epic monsters.

Rell steals at least 1.5 - 3 Armor and Magic Resist. Does not steal from minions or epic monsters.

q.name: Shattering Strike

description.normalized: Thrusts her lance, dealing 70 / 130 / 190 / 250 (+50% AP) magic damage, stunning for 0.65 seconds, and destroying all shields. Does not break shields on monsters.

q.rawParsedText:
Thrusts her lance, dealing 70 / 130 / 190 / 250 (+50% AP) magic damage, stunning for 0.65 seconds, and destroying all shields.

Does not break shields on monsters.

w.name: Ferromancy - Crash Down / Mount Up

description.normalized: Mounted Alacrity (Passive): Gains 15 Movement Speed while mounted. Ferromancy: Crash Down (Active): Leaps off her mount, dealing 70 / 100 / 130 / 160 (+50% AP) magic damage. Enemies are also knocked up. Gains a shield that absorbs 30 / 60 / 90 / 120 (+13% max Health) damage, which lasts until she remounts. Rell then enters Armored Form, which lets her cast Ferromancy: Mount up. Armored Form Dismounted Resilience (Passive): Gains 12% Armor and 12% Magic Resist. Gains 20% Attack Speed. Gains 75 Attack Range. Ferromancy Mount Up (Active): Mounts up and gains 30% decaying Movement Speed for 2 seconds. Her next attack within 3.5 seconds knocks up enemies and throws them behind her, dealing an additional 15 / 30 / 45 / 60 (+35% AP) magic damage. She then enters Mounted Form, which lets her cast Ferromancy: Crash Down.

w.rawParsedText:
Mounted Alacrity (Passive):

Gains 15 Movement Speed while mounted.

Ferromancy: Crash Down (Active):

Leaps off her mount, dealing 70 / 100 / 130 / 160 (+50% AP) magic damage. Enemies are also knocked up. Gains a shield that absorbs 30 / 60 / 90 / 120 (+13% max Health) damage, which lasts until she remounts.

Rell then enters Armored Form, which lets her cast Ferromancy: Mount up.

Armored Form

Dismounted Resilience (Passive):

Gains 12% Armor and 12% Magic Resist. Gains 20% Attack Speed. Gains 75 Attack Range.

Ferromancy Mount Up (Active):

Mounts up and gains 30% decaying Movement Speed for 2 seconds. Her next attack within 3.5 seconds knocks up enemies and throws them behind her, dealing an additional 15 / 30 / 45 / 60 (+35% AP) magic damage.

She then enters Mounted Form, which lets her cast Ferromancy: Crash Down.

e.name: Full Tilt

description.normalized: Charges, granting herself and a target allied champion nearby 10% Movement Speed. If no target is selected, the nearest allied champion will receive the bonus. This bonus increases to 25% for 3 seconds when facing enemy champions or each other. Rell's next attack or Shattering Strike explodes in an area, dealing 5.5% / 6% / 6.5% / 7% (+0.03 AP) of the target's max Health as magic damage. Deals up to 150 damage against monsters and structures.

r.name: Magnet Storm

description.normalized: Explodes in fury, pulling nearby enemy champions toward herself. Continuous Pull: While Magnet Storm is active, constantly pulls nearby enemies toward herself and deals 120 / 200 / 280 (+100% AP) magic damage over 2 seconds.
